msgs.t: Chapter Five by Monday please. Conclusions and recommendations.
And the recommendations must come from YOUR findings.

slides.b: Your findings, objective by objective, in a few lines each. No new numbers here.
Objective one, conclusion one. If an objective has no conclusion, your supervisor will ask why.
Each one points back to a result: "Since 62% said X, the county should Y." No wishlist.
Name the office, the school, the SACCO. A recommendation with no owner is just an opinion.
Two or three gaps your study couldn't cover. Short. Then stop.

Tell Toso your objectives and paste your findings. Get a structured conclusions and recommendations chapter in Word to work from.
Pay with M-Pesa. No card, no monthly bill.
